text: DP World Limited's audited FY2025 financial statements state that Port & Free Zone World FZE ('PFZW'), a wholly owned subsidiary of Dubai World Corporation, holds 100% of the company's issued and outstanding share capital, and that the Government of Dubai is the ultimate owner of the group.

source.name: DP World Annual Report 2025 (consolidated financial statements), DP World Limited, DIFC, year ended 31 December 2025
source.quote: Port & Free Zone World FZE ('PFZW' or 'the Parent Company'), a wholly owned subsidiary of Dubai World Corporation ('the Intermediate Parent'), holds 100% of the Company's issued and outstanding
